title: Mitchell TTX · logistics under attack
subtitle: Dispersal, prepositioning and constrained force design
description: Research visualization of the logistics judgments from the Mitchell Institute 2024 TTX: fuel, weapons, personnel, lift, alternate operating surfaces and the shift toward EW/decoy CCA when missile and logistics supplies constrain a notional Pacific campaign.
assumptions: Grounded in pages 24-25 and Figures 11-12 of the February 2025 report; these were TTX team assessments, not validated field logistics movements.

TTX planners considered southern Japan and northern Philippines for dispersed CCA operations but did not publish particular coordinates, base inventories or resupply routes; all displayed movement is fictional.
The report found initial unconstrained plans risked consuming all in-theater air-to-air missile inventory in less than a week; the visualization does not calculate inventory burn rates.
Figure 12 shows weapon-sortie and EW/decoy-sortie proportions under constrained and unconstrained logistics; those published percentages are research findings, not simulated site-by-site rates.

phases.title: Preposition CCA and Munitions
phases.narrative: Teams proposed prepositioning replacements at dispersed forward sites because high-risk C-130 resupply near the battlespace would be difficult (p. 24).

phases.title: Distributed Launch Posture
phases.narrative: Teams considered locations in southern Japan and northern Philippines, shorter runways and road/rocket launch options; site markers are not disclosed TTX coordinates.

phases.title: Sortie Generation Requirements
phases.narrative: Fuel, personnel, munitions and support equipment were assessed as necessary for sustaining high-tempo CCA operations.

phases.title: Resupply Risk and Theater Lift
phases.narrative: The TTX identified risky C-130 replenishment and considered air-launched CCA and uninhabited mobility concepts instead (p. 24).

phases.title: Adapt Under Munitions Constraints
phases.narrative: Figure 12 records a shift toward EW/decoy sortie concepts as weapons inventories constrained plans; it is not a tactical basing movement model.

phases.title: Constrained Logistics Findings
phases.narrative: Figure 11 reports combined requests for expendable CCA at 145% of the TTX notional available inventory; the exercise highlights limits rather than a validated sustainable sortie rate.
